lemma tariff (S : Schedule) {h N p : ℕ} (hh : h≤N) (β : ℝ) (H : Seam G (S.side N p) β)
    (a : ι → Site (S.side h p)) (hc : Injective a)
    (O Z : ι → Config G (S.side N p) → ℂ) (c e : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Interior ((tilesAt S p hh).chamber 0) (O i))
    (hF : ∀ i, Interior ((tilesAt S p hh).chamber 0) (Z i))
    (hO : ∀ i, (tilesAt S p hh).rootTest β (O i) ≤ c i)
    (hZ : ∀ i, (tilesAt S p hh).rootTest β (Z i-O i) ≤ e i) :
    ‖moment β (fun U => ∏ i, Z i (translate (anchor S p hh (a i)) U)) -

proof_context.conclusion: tariff bounds the difference of the moments of two products of interior observables by a telescoped sum using only the root tests c i and e i.

lemma spent_shifts {h : ℕ} {v : ι → C.book.Token} {w : κ → C.book.Token}
    (Z : ∀ i, Figures C (v i) h) (D : ∀ i, Figures C (w i) h)
    {f : Extraction.Order} (H : C.Makes) (hz : ∀ i, (Z i).Gives f) (hd : ∀ i, (D i).Gives f) (q)
    {x : ι → Cover} {y : κ → Cover} (hx : Injective x) (hy : Injective y) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i<j) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, f.late fun N p =>
      ‖moment (C.beta N p) (placed Z (offset x t i) q N p * placed D (offset y t j) q N p)-
        moment (C.beta N p) (literal h v (offset x t i) N p * literal h w (offset y t j) N p)‖ ≤ expense (combined Z D) q := by
  have he := spent_pair Z H D hz hd q
  unfold Extraction.Order.late at *
  filter_upwards [real_pair hx hy i j hij] with t ht
  filter_upwards [he,f.per.cofinal.eventually (wrap_late C.S h _ ht)] with k hk hp
  filter_upwards [hk] with a ha using ha _ _ hp

proof_context.conclusion: spent_shifts shows eventually in the shift t that the moments of products at offset positions match the literal products within the combined expense, for large periods.
